comment: Real eth_getLogs output for a single Ethereum mainnet block, filtered on the Transfer topic0, captured 2026-10-29. This block was chosen from 12 candidates for its HIGH ERC-721 density (43 of 535 logs, ~8%) so the golden test exercises both standards. It is therefore NOT representative: the measured mainnet average is 1.6% ERC-721 (see docs/measurements.md).
